items.title: Joel Dorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: I got in hassles with Wexler, I got in hassles with Ahmet, you know.

ctx.x: Well first of all I was a wise ass kid and I was high most of the time so I didn’t exactly comport myself the way somebody should. Secondly I had had a lot of success and nobody bothered with me while I was making jazz records for Nesuhi. When I started to get hits with Flack and Midler and Donny Hathaway and people like that I had too much help. I wasn’t in the mood for that shit you know, to be honest with you. I got in hassles with Wexler, I got in hassles with Ahmet, you know. I just wanted to be — Nesuhi put…
